title: Destination
description: Where a watch's events go (ADR 0043, 0059): one of the account's webhooks, an agent's inbox, or a linked chat (channel); or `speak`, which says `text` through a camera's speaker when the watch fires (ADR 0069).

id.description: A webhook id (whk_…), an agent id (agt_…), a channel id (chn_…) or, for speak, the camera's source id (src_…).

text.description: speak only: what to say through the camera's speaker, at most 30 seconds of speech. Required for speak.
